# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

The `/v2/users` endpoint has a breaking change. We divided the `name` field into two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. We removed the old `name` field. You must change your code before you use this version.

This version adds the `--incremental` flag. The flag tells sqlpipe to read only the new records. Use this flag to decrease the time for large tasks.

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1. This change decreases the write time for large data exports.
